user.title: Ready Home
user.description: Track emergency supplies and measure readiness. Name this profile (default Ready Home). Generic names appear as Ready Home in the UI; other names become a suffix, e.g. Ready Home (Cabin). The profile also sets the entity id prefix.

data.name: Profile name
data.number_of_people: Number of people in the household

init.title: Ready Home options
init.description: Submit saves and returns here. Close when finished.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Rename this readiness profile (default Ready Home). Generic names appear as Ready Home; other names become a suffix, e.g. Ready Home (Cabin). The profile also sets the entity id prefix.

data.water_liters_per_person_per_day: Water liters per person per day

lists.title: Locations and categories
lists.description: Categories label items. Food and water category lists decide which categories count toward readiness. A category cannot be both food and water. To rename an existing location or category (and update items that use it), use Rename location or Rename category.

data_description.food_categories: Items in these categories count toward food readiness (calories).
data_description.water_categories: Items in these categories count toward water readiness (liters).

rename_location.title: Rename location
rename_location.description: Rename a storage location. All inventory items that use the old name are updated.

rename_category.title: Rename category
rename_category.description: Rename a category. All inventory items that use the old name are updated, including food and water readiness mappings.

error.category_overlap: A category cannot be both food and water
error.name_exists: That name is already in use
error.name_not_found: Choose a name from the current list
